capstone.title: Secure the Small Office Workstation
capstone.desc: Multi-step simulated engagement: map the office network, harden a Linux and a Windows host, triage logs for a brute-force attempt, script a report and rank the risks.

cert_note: Supports foundations for CompTIA ITF+ and Network+ topics (OSI, ports, DNS). Guide only, not an official prep.

can_do: Define cybersecurity and distinguish red, blue and purple team work
Match common job roles to their daily tasks
Apply basic legal and ethical rules to security testing

lessons.title: What Cybersecurity Is and Why It Matters
lessons.goal: Define cybersecurity and explain its goals of protecting systems, data and people from misuse.

lessons.title: Red, Blue and Purple Teams, Job Roles
lessons.goal: Contrast offensive, defensive and collaborative teams and map SOC, pentest and GRC roles.

lessons.title: Famous Breaches: Target, Equifax, SolarWinds
lessons.goal: Explain root causes of three major breaches and the controls that would have limited each.

lessons.title: Ethics, the Law and How to Study
lessons.goal: Describe authorization, scope, CFAA-style laws and responsible disclosure, and plan a study routine.

labs.title: Sort the Job Roles
labs.task: Read six short job tasks and assign each to the correct role: SOC analyst, pentester, GRC, or incident responder.

labs.title: Breach Timeline Triage
labs.task: Review a breach timeline and mark the initial access, lateral movement and detection gap events.

labs.title: Authorized or Not?
labs.task: Answer client requests and decide which are in scope, need written authorization, or must be refused.

checkpoint.focus: Team colors, role responsibilities, breach root causes, authorization and legal boundaries

can_do: Convert between binary, decimal, hex and ASCII
Identify the roles of CPU, RAM, storage and the OS kernel
Describe processes, file types and virtual machine isolation

lessons.title: CPU, RAM and Storage
lessons.goal: Explain how the CPU, volatile RAM and persistent storage (HDD, SSD) cooperate to run a program.

lessons.title: Operating Systems and the Kernel
lessons.goal: Describe kernel vs user space, drivers, system calls and the main OS families.

lessons.title: Binary, Hex and ASCII
lessons.goal: Convert values between binary, decimal and hex and decode ASCII text by hand.

lessons.title: Files, Extensions and Processes
lessons.goal: Explain file signatures (magic bytes), process vs program, PID, and parent-child relationships.

lessons.title: Virtual Machines and Hypervisors
lessons.goal: Explain Type 1 vs Type 2 hypervisors, snapshots, and why VMs are used for safe analysis.

labs.title: Binary and Hex Converter Drill
labs.task: Convert ten values among binary, decimal and hex, then decode a short ASCII string byte by byte.

labs.title: Spot the Fake Extension
labs.task: Inspect file headers and identify which files have extensions that do not match their magic bytes.

labs.title: Process Tree Walkthrough
labs.task: Run ps to list processes, find a parent PID, and identify the process that owns a given file.

labs.title: Design a Safe Analysis Lab
labs.task: Place a VM, host-only network and snapshot on a canvas so malware samples cannot reach the host network.

checkpoint.focus: Number bases, ASCII, hardware roles, process basics, hypervisor types and VM isolation

can_do: Calculate subnets and distinguish IP from MAC addressing
Trace a packet through the OSI and TCP/IP layers
Troubleshoot connectivity using ping, traceroute and DNS tools

lessons.title: IPv4, IPv6 and MAC Addresses
lessons.goal: Read IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, private ranges (RFC 1918) and MAC addresses with OUI prefixes.

lessons.title: Subnet Masks and CIDR
lessons.goal: Calculate network, broadcast and host range for a CIDR block such as 192.168.1.0/26.

lessons.title: OSI and TCP/IP Models
lessons.goal: Map protocols and devices to the seven OSI layers and the four TCP/IP layers.

lessons.title: TCP vs UDP and the Three-Way Handshake
lessons.goal: Explain SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK, flags, reliability and when UDP is chosen over TCP.

lessons.title: Ports and Common Services
lessons.goal: Recall well-known ports (22, 53, 80, 443, 3389) and explain sockets and listening states.

lessons.title: DNS, DHCP and NAT
lessons.goal: Describe DNS record types, the DHCP DORA exchange and how NAT/PAT shares one public IP.

lessons.title: Routers, Switches and Wi-Fi
lessons.goal: Explain switch CAM tables, router tables, VLAN basics, and Wi-Fi standards, SSIDs and WPA2/WPA3.

lessons.title: ping, traceroute, nslookup and ARP
lessons.goal: Use ICMP tools to locate a fault and read TTL, hop latency and ARP cache output.

labs.title: Subnet Calculator Practice
labs.task: Given six CIDR blocks, enter network address, broadcast address and usable host count.

labs.title: Read the Handshake
labs.task: Open a capture and label the SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK packets, then find the server port.

labs.title: Layer the Packet
labs.task: Drag headers into place to build an Ethernet, IP, TCP and HTTP frame in the correct order.

labs.title: DNS Lookup Troubleshoot
labs.task: Run nslookup and dig for A, MX and NS records and find why one hostname fails to resolve.

labs.title: DHCP Lease Debug
labs.task: Read DHCP logs to find a client stuck on a 169.254.x.x address and identify the missing step.

labs.title: Where Does the Packet Die?
labs.task: Run ping and traceroute on a simulated network and locate the hop that drops traffic.

checkpoint.focus: Subnetting, OSI layers, TCP vs UDP, common ports, DNS/DHCP/NAT roles, ICMP tool output

can_do: Break down a URL and read an HTTP request and response
Explain cookies, sessions and the front-end stack
Write basic SQL SELECT queries and read JSON from an API

lessons.title: URLs and the Request Lifecycle
lessons.goal: Parse a URL into scheme, host, port, path, query and fragment and trace a page load through DNS and TCP.

lessons.title: HTTP Methods, Headers and Status Codes
lessons.goal: Interpret GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, key headers and 2xx, 3xx, 4xx and 5xx status codes.

lessons.title: Cookies, Sessions and HTTPS
lessons.goal: Explain Set-Cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), session IDs and TLS in transit.

lessons.title: HTML, CSS and JavaScript Basics
lessons.goal: Describe the DOM, how forms submit data and what client-side JavaScript can and cannot be trusted with.

lessons.title: APIs, REST and JSON
lessons.goal: Read a REST endpoint, a JSON body and an API key or bearer token header.

lessons.title: Databases and SQL Basics
lessons.goal: Write SELECT, WHERE, INSERT and JOIN statements and explain why user input must be parameterized.

labs.title: Inspect a Request
labs.task: Intercept a login request in the proxy and identify the method, headers, cookie and body parameters.

labs.title: Status Code Detective
labs.task: Read web server logs and explain what each 301, 403, 404 and 500 line means for the user.

labs.title: Cookie Flag Audit
labs.task: Check three responses and note which cookies miss HttpOnly, Secure or SameSite.

labs.title: Query the Customers Table
labs.task: Run SELECT queries with WHERE and ORDER BY on a sample database to answer four lookup questions.

checkpoint.focus: HTTP anatomy, status codes, cookie attributes, DOM and JS basics, JSON, SQL SELECT syntax

can_do: Navigate the Linux file system with pwd, ls and cd
Use absolute and relative paths correctly
Look up command options with man and --help

lessons.title: What Linux Is: Kernel, Distros, Shells
lessons.goal: Explain the Linux kernel, distributions such as Debian and Ubuntu, and bash as a shell.

lessons.title: The Prompt and Command Anatomy
lessons.goal: Read a prompt and break a command into program, options and arguments.

lessons.title: pwd, ls and cd
lessons.goal: Move around and list directories using ls -l, -a and -h and cd shortcuts like ~ and -.

lessons.title: The Filesystem Hierarchy and Paths
lessons.goal: Distinguish absolute from relative paths and know /etc, /var, /home, /tmp and /bin.

lessons.title: man Pages and Getting Help
lessons.goal: Search man pages, read the synopsis and flags, and use --help and apropos.

labs.title: First Terminal Session
labs.task: Run pwd, ls and cd to reach a hidden project folder and report its full path.

labs.title: Path Puzzle
labs.task: Reach five target directories using only relative paths, then repeat with absolute paths.

labs.title: Find Where Logs Live
labs.task: Browse /var/log and /etc in the explorer and match each file to its purpose.

labs.title: Decode the Flags
labs.task: Use man to find which ls option sorts by time, shows sizes and lists hidden files, then run it.

checkpoint.focus: Prompt anatomy, pwd/ls/cd, absolute vs relative paths, FHS directories, man usage

can_do: Create, copy, move and delete files and directories safely
Read files with cat, less, head and tail
Locate files using wildcards and find

lessons.title: mkdir and touch
lessons.goal: Create directories (mkdir -p) and empty files and understand timestamps.

lessons.title: cp, mv and rm
lessons.goal: Copy, rename, move and delete with -r and -i flags and explain why rm has no recycle bin.

lessons.title: Reading Files: cat, less, head, tail
lessons.goal: Choose the right viewer and follow a growing log with tail -f.

lessons.title: Wildcards and Globbing
lessons.goal: Use *, ? and [a-z] patterns to act on groups of files and predict what a glob matches.

lessons.title: Hidden Files and find
lessons.goal: Find files by name, type, size and mtime with find and reveal dotfiles such as .bashrc.

labs.title: Build a Project Tree
labs.task: Create a nested directory layout with mkdir -p and touch, then verify it with ls -R.

labs.title: Safe Cleanup
labs.task: Copy and move report files, then delete only the .tmp files using wildcards and rm -i.

labs.title: Follow the Log
labs.task: Use tail and head on a simulated auth log to find the most recent failed login lines.

labs.title: Hunt the Large File
labs.task: Use find with -name, -size and -mtime to locate a 50 MB file modified in the last day.

checkpoint.focus: File manipulation commands, rm risks, viewer choice, glob patterns, find options

can_do: Interpret ls -l output and numeric permissions
Change ownership and modes with chown and chmod
Apply sudo and least privilege correctly

lessons.title: Users, Groups and /etc/passwd
lessons.goal: Read /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow and /etc/group and use id, whoami and groups.

lessons.title: Reading ls -l Output
lessons.goal: Decode the type bit, owner, group, others, links, size and date fields in ls -l.

lessons.title: chmod: Symbolic and Octal Modes
lessons.goal: Set permissions with u+x style and numeric modes such as 640 and 755.

lessons.title: chown, chgrp and Special Bits
lessons.goal: Change owners and groups and explain setuid, setgid and the sticky bit on /tmp.

lessons.title: sudo and Least Privilege
lessons.goal: Use sudo and sudoers safely, explain root risks and why 777 is a vulnerability.

labs.title: Decode the Permissions
labs.task: Read ten ls -l lines and state who can read, write and execute each file.

labs.title: Fix the Broken Script
labs.task: Apply chmod to make a script executable by its owner only and verify with ls -l.

labs.title: Lock Down a Secrets File
labs.task: Use chown and chmod 600 so only the service account can read an API key file.

labs.title: Audit sudoers and Accounts
labs.task: Review /etc/passwd and sudoers entries to find an extra UID 0 user and an unrestricted sudo rule.

checkpoint.focus: Permission bits, octal math, chown/chmod usage, setuid risk, sudo and least privilege

can_do: Search and transform text with grep, pipes and redirects
Inspect and stop processes with ps, top and kill
Check updates and network state with apt, ip, ping and ss

lessons.title: grep and Regular Patterns
lessons.goal: Search with grep -i, -r, -n and -v and combine simple patterns to filter logs.

lessons.title: Pipes and Redirects
lessons.goal: Chain commands with |, redirect with >, >> and 2>, and use sort, uniq -c and wc.

lessons.title: Processes: ps, top and kill
lessons.goal: List processes, read CPU and memory use and end them with kill, kill -9 and signals.

lessons.title: Package Management with apt
lessons.goal: Update and upgrade with apt, search and install packages and explain why patching reduces risk.

lessons.title: Network Checks: ip, ping and ss
lessons.goal: Read ip a and ip route, test reachability with ping, and list listening ports with ss -tulpn.

labs.title: Failed Logins by IP
labs.task: Pipe grep, sort and uniq -c over an auth log to rank source IPs by failed attempts.

labs.title: Runaway Process
labs.task: Use top and ps to find a process using 95 percent CPU and terminate it with the right signal.

labs.title: Patch the Box
labs.task: Run apt update, list upgradable packages and install a security update for a vulnerable package.

labs.title: Who Is Listening?
labs.task: Run ss -tulpn and flag the unexpected service listening on 0.0.0.0, then trace its PID.

checkpoint.focus: grep options, pipes vs redirects, process signals, apt workflow, ip and ss output

can_do: Navigate the Windows file system, registry and services
Use Task Manager, cmd and PowerShell for basic inspection
Explain UAC, Active Directory basics, Defender and the firewall

lessons.title: Windows File System and NTFS
lessons.goal: Describe C:\Windows, Users, Program Files, NTFS permissions and alternate data streams.

lessons.title: Users, Groups and UAC
lessons.goal: Explain local users, the Administrators group, SIDs and how UAC prompts limit elevation.

lessons.title: The Registry and Services
lessons.goal: Navigate HKLM and HKCU hives, Run keys and the Services console, and note persistence locations.

lessons.title: Task Manager, cmd and PowerShell
lessons.goal: Use tasklist, ipconfig, netstat and PowerShell cmdlets like Get-Process and Get-Service.

lessons.title: Active Directory Introduction
lessons.goal: Explain domains, domain controllers, OUs, group policy and Kerberos login at a high level.

lessons.title: Windows Defender and Firewall
lessons.goal: Configure Defender scans, real-time protection and inbound firewall rules for profiles.

labs.title: Find the Autorun Entry
labs.task: Browse registry Run keys and flag the entry that launches an unknown executable at login.

labs.title: PowerShell Inspection
labs.task: Run Get-Process, Get-Service and Get-LocalUser to list stopped services and unexpected local accounts.

labs.title: Firewall Rule Fix
labs.task: Create an inbound rule that allows only RDP from one subnet and disable a risky open rule.

labs.title: Active Directory Tree
labs.task: Build a domain with OUs, users and groups and attach a group policy to the correct OU.

checkpoint.focus: Windows paths, UAC, registry persistence keys, PowerShell cmdlets, AD terms, firewall rules

can_do: Write Bash and Python scripts using variables, conditions and loops
Read files and extract data with regex
Automate small repetitive tasks with functions

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.goal: Declare variables in Bash and Python and use strings, integers, lists and dictionaries.

lessons.title: Conditions and Comparisons
lessons.goal: Use if/elif/else, test operators and exit codes to branch in Bash and Python.

lessons.title: Loops
lessons.goal: Iterate with for and while loops over lists, ranges and lines of a file.

lessons.title: Functions and Arguments
lessons.goal: Define functions, pass arguments such as $1 and sys.argv and return values.

lessons.title: Reading Files and Regex
lessons.goal: Read files line by line and match IPs, emails and timestamps with regular expressions.

lessons.title: Automating a Small Task
lessons.goal: Build a script that parses a log, counts events and writes a summary report.

labs.title: Fix the Script
labs.task: Repair a Python script with a syntax error and a wrong comparison until it passes the tests.

labs.title: Ping Sweep Loop
labs.task: Complete a Bash for loop that pings a host range and prints only the live addresses.

labs.title: Regex IP Extractor
labs.task: Write a regex that extracts every IPv4 address from a sample log and count unique matches.

labs.title: Log Summary Tool
labs.task: Finish a Python function that reads a log and prints the top five failed-login usernames.

checkpoint.focus: Syntax of variables, conditions and loops, function arguments, file reading, regex basics

can_do: Apply the CIA triad to classify security failures
Rank risks using threat, vulnerability and impact
Choose layered controls and write basic policy statements

lessons.title: The CIA Triad and Beyond
lessons.goal: Define confidentiality, integrity and availability and add authenticity and non-repudiation.

lessons.title: Threats, Vulnerabilities and Risk
lessons.goal: Distinguish threat, vulnerability, exploit and risk and compute likelihood times impact.

lessons.title: Attack Surface and Threat Actors
lessons.goal: Identify exposed entry points and describe actors from script kiddies to nation states.

lessons.title: Defense in Depth and Least Privilege
lessons.goal: Layer preventive, detective and corrective controls and apply least privilege and separation of duties.

lessons.title: Security Policies and Frameworks
lessons.goal: Explain policies, standards, procedures and frameworks like NIST CSF and ISO 27001.

labs.title: Classify the Incident
labs.task: Read eight incidents and label each as a confidentiality, integrity or availability failure.

labs.title: Build a Risk Register
labs.task: Score five findings by likelihood and impact and sort them into a prioritized risk register.

labs.title: Layer the Defenses
labs.task: Place firewall, EDR, MFA, backups and logging on a diagram to cover a given attack path.

labs.title: Shrink the Attack Surface
labs.task: Review a server config, disable unneeded services and ports, and apply a minimal-privilege account.

checkpoint.focus: CIA classification, risk terms and scoring, attack surface, layered controls, policy vs standard
